If a quote has needs_same_vendor_sku, the quote selected for that other SKU must come from the same vendor. For each vendor, compute gross=sum(units*unit_cents). If that vendor's selected units >= tier_units, apply its tier_bps discount to the entire gross; round the vendor's merchandise total to cents, with exact halves rounded up. Add shipping_cents unless the PRE-DISCOUNT gross >= free_shipping_gross. Subtract rebate_cents only if at least two different SKUs are selected from that vendor AND the POST-DISCOUNT merchandise total >= rebate_merchandise_min. All thresholds are inclusive. Total cost is the sum over all vendors used. Find the globally minimum total cost in cents, not the result of a greedy per-SKU choice.
